item.title: Learning Log - January 21, 2025
item.author: sol0608sol@gmail.com (So Momma)
item.dc:creator: So Momma
item.description:
What I Learned Today

Git Command

git diff origin/develop > diff.txt

I learned how to output the difference between the develop branch and the current branch to a file. This is useful for reviews and checking changes.

About Schema

I deepened my understanding of database schema design. Table structure design is an important foundation for applications.

Today’s Achievements

  • ✅ Understood schema design
  • ✅ Successfully started a new blog
  • ✅ Selected Hugo as the technology
  • ✅ Installed a Windows-style AltTab application

Small steps matter. Let’s keep going tomorrow!

item.title: Starting My Blog
item.author: sol0608sol@gmail.com (So Momma)
item.dc:creator: So Momma
item.description:
I’m an Engineer, Starting My Blog

I’ll be accumulating technical output here. Built with Hugo + Vercel for a blazing-fast environment.

Tech Stack

  • Static Site Generator: Hugo
  • Theme: hugo-brewm
  • Deployment: Vercel

I love Hugo’s simplicity and Vercel’s fast deployment.

Future Plans

  • 📝 Technical Notes: Memos of things learned and points where I got stuck during development
  • 📚 Book Reviews: Reading records of technical books and other books
  • 💭 Poems: Daily insights and thoughts as an engineer
print("Hello, ChiriTsumomma!")

I want to accumulate small learnings and connect them to great growth.
